title: Memory Arbiter
statement: Design a memory arbiter that grants one of three requesters access to a shared memory bus based on fixed priority. The highest-priority request should be granted while lower priorities wait. The grant state should be maintained until the active request releases the bus.
module_signature: module memory_arbiter_3to1(input clk, input rst, input [2:0] req, output reg [2:0] grant);
behavior: Only one grant may be asserted at a time.
Grants follow fixed priority from req[2] down to req[0].
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Do not use asynchronous priority encoders that bypass state.
hint: Use registered grant outputs and update them on the clock edge.
